quality.notes: Apple's PNG rendition of the PNG upload at native size (lossless; requested instead of the lossy variant the page or API advertises). A store re-render, not the untouched upload file. Apple writes an identifier into each render of a rendition (a 26-character token in EXIF UserComment, and in XMP dc:creator for PNG). Requests served from one CDN cache entry return the same bytes, but a fresh render of the same URL (a cache miss) carries a new token: different bytes and SHA-256 with identical pixels. SHA-256 verifies the archived file; compare a re-fetch with it by decoded pixels.
